articles.title: United Gives MileagePlus Credit Cardholders More Miles, Exclusive Flight Discounts
articles.mainIdea: United Gives MileagePlus Credit Cardholders More Miles, Exclusive Flight Discounts
articles.summary: PR Newswire: United Gives MileagePlus Credit Cardholders More Miles, Exclusive Flight Discounts. United Airlines is giving travelers three new reasons to hold and use a United MileagePlus® credit or debit card: the ability to earn up to twice as many miles as non-cardholders, at least 10% off United award tickets and access to special inventory of its lowest-priced award seats.

articles.title: United Airlines Scores Relative Strength Rating Upgrade; Hits Key Threshold
articles.mainIdea: United Airlines Scores Relative Strength Rating Upgrade; Hits Key Threshold
articles.summary: Investor's Business Daily: United Airlines Scores Relative Strength Rating Upgrade; Hits Key Threshold. On Wednesday, shares of United Airlines jumped nearly 4% in midday trading. UAL is very close to an all-time high and could top it as early as today as the airlines sector perks up. Its gains come on the heels of a lift for Southwest Airlines, which shot up 18.7% on Jan. 29 after that carrier reported outstanding earnings results. Related tickers mentioned: LUV.
